dispositions.evidence: The original image has inter- at the end of one physical line and meddle on the next. A physical line-break hyphen cannot alone settle whether the intended running spelling included a hyphen.
dispositions.uncertainty: Orthographic hyphenation not independently settled by the line break.

dispositions.evidence: Original print has to- / morrow across physical lines in 27:1; independent same-edition 3:28 prints to-morrow unbroken.
dispositions.uncertainty: The line-break on 27:1 alone would not determine orthography.
